# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline pixel memory-match game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 total) shuffled each game
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter tracks each pair flip
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- New Game button resets the board
- Keyboard-accessible cards and controls
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with system fonts

## How to Run

Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network connection required.

## Controls

- Click or tap a card to flip it
- Use Tab to focus cards and the New Game button
- Press Enter or Space on a focused card to flip it
- Press Enter or Space on the New Game button to reset

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure
- `style.css` — styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — game logic
